name: glass
summary: A Liquid Glass surface: native on iOS 26, emulated with blur and a rim elsewhere.
props: Frosted, or more see-through for media behind.
Colour washed into the glass, e.g. your accent for a selected state.
iOS 26: the glass shimmers and bounces under touch.
Corner radius, or 'full' for pills and circles.
Blur strength 1–100 where blur is emulated.
Specular rim + hairline edge, and the soft drop shadow (emulated glass).
Force light or dark glass, e.g. over a photo.
Shapes inside melt together on iOS 26 when closer than spacing.
Android real blur: put the content behind the glass in GlassBackdrop, glass UI as its siblings. GlassIsolate opts a subtree (e.g. a Modal) out.
Whether native Liquid Glass is on; text colours that read on glass.
behavior: With interactive, iOS 26 glass shimmers and bounces under the finger. Elsewhere the prop is ignored.
iOS 26 renders real Liquid Glass that GlassGroup can merge; older iOS uses a system material blur. Android blurs inside GlassProvider + GlassBackdrop and falls back to a frosted fill.
Blurs what is behind it with a CSS backdrop blur. Wherever glass is emulated it adds a specular rim, a hairline edge and a soft shadow.
